body.userscript: //화면 좌측 서비스 리스트 select시 호출되는 함수(리스트에서 호출됨) dataOutput.addScreen('AD_019_2'); gridObj.postConnection('/SepoaGrid.sux',['PROCESS_ID=sepoa.svc.admin.AD_019_4','mode=doQuery']); gridObj.clearAll(false); //조회시 부모화면의 id가 a인 것의 아이콘중 add,delete,save 아이콘을 활성화 한다. callFunction('parent','changeHeaderIcon',['a','show','delete,save']); dataOutput.addScreen('AD_019_2'); if(gridObj.getGridChangedRows("SELECTED").length > 0 && Confirm(Sepoa.cache.text.get('MESSAGE.1015'),function(result){ if(result){ gridObj.editStop(); gridObj.postTransaction('/SepoaGrid.sux',['PROCESS_ID=sepoa.svc.admin.AD_019_4','mode=doSave','method=doDelete'],'SELECTED'); } })); var checked=gridObj.getCheckedRows(gridObj.getColIndexById('REPRESENT_CTRL')); var value = gridObj.cells(checked,gridObj.getColIndexById('CTRL_NAME_LOC')).getValue(); Confirm(value+Sepoa.cache.text.get('MESSAGE.5109'),function(result){ if(result){ dataOutput.addScreen('AD_019_2'); gridObj.editStop(); gridObj.postTransaction('/SepoaGrid.sux',['PROCESS_ID=sepoa.svc.admin.AD_019_4','mode=doSave']); } }); var mode = obj.mode; var status = obj.status; var message = obj.message; if(status=='true'){ Alert(message); callFunction(['parent','parent','parent','AD_019_2'],'doFormLoad', []); callFunction(['parent','AD_019_5'],'doQueryByList', [dataOutput.getValue('CTRL_PERSON_ID')]); doQueryByList(); }else{ Alert(message); }
